The Iterated Weighted Least Squares Method

Source: R/iwls.R
Iwls-class.Rd

Iwls is the S7 class of the scoring step that statmod() uses for the jointly fitted smooth block. An object of this class carries the solver, the budget, the stopping rule and the constants of the loop. Build one with iwls(), which validates every argument; this raw constructor does not.

The matrix that the step inverts is not an argument of iwls(): it is the argument inner_information of statmod(). statmod() stores the matrix that it settled in the properties hessian, backup, switching and repair_floor, which iwls() initializes to an unsettled state.

Usage

Iwls(
  solver = IwlsSolver(),
  maxit = integer(0),
  tol = integer(0),
  criterion = NULL,
  step_halving = integer(0),
  decrement_limit = integer(0),
  switch_after = integer(0),
  switch_rate = integer(0),
  hessian = distributions7::Information(),
  backup = NULL,
  switching = logical(0),
  repair_floor = integer(0)
)

Arguments

solver

How the step is solved, an object that inherits from IwlsSolver: solve_qr(), solve_svd() or solve_chol().

maxit

The iteration budget, a single positive whole number.

tol

The stopping tolerance on the score per observation, a single positive number.

criterion

An optimizers7 criterion object driving the loop in place of tol, or NULL for the built-in rule.

step_halving

The number of halvings tried after the full step before a step is abandoned, a single non-negative whole number. The line search tries the full step and then at most step_halving halved steps, so 0 tries only the full step.

decrement_limit

The value under which the built-in rule reads the Newton decrement as small, a single positive number.

switch_after

A single number: the iteration after which a run on the expected information continues on the observed one when the choice was settled from auto_info(). Inf never switches.

switch_rate

A single number, or NA: the ratio of consecutive scores above which a run on the expected information counts as contracting slowly. NA never counts a run as slow.

hessian

The information that the step inverts, once settled: an object that inherits from distributions7::Information, set by statmod() from its argument inner_information. An auto_info() object stands for an unsettled choice, which iwls_resolve() settles against the family.

backup

NULL, or the distributions7::expected_info() object that takes the step where the observed step finds no acceptable point. It is set only by settling an auto_info() on the observed information.

switching

Whether the run continues on the observed information after switch_after iterations or a slow contraction. It is set only by settling an auto_info() on the expected information.

repair_floor

The repair_floor of the auto_info() that was settled, or NA when the choice was named.

Value

An object of class Iwls with one property per argument above, and each property holds the value that was passed.

See also

iwls(), the constructor to use.

Examples

S7::S7_inherits(iwls(), Iwls)
#> [1] TRUE
iwls()@solver
#> QR solver (tol 1e-07, floor 1e-08)
